title: Figure One: Normalised specific absorption rate (SAR) vs frequency in living organisms
description: Line graph labeled 'Figure One' plotting 'Normalised specific absorption rate (W/kg per W/m^2)' against frequency (30, 300, 400, 2000 MHz), with a peak in the resonance range. Vertical bands are labeled 'Subresonance range', 'Resonance range' (Whole body, Partial body (head)), 'Hot spot range' and 'Surface absorption range'. The caption credits WHO 'Electromagnetic fields (300 Hz to 300 GHz)' Environmental Health Criteria 137; the text below is headed 'A. The Effects That Burn'.
